_note: Falcon's published picks + behavior (Glitch tweets/UI) = labeled data to reverse-engineer. EXECUTED trades (from tweets) are the ground truth; the 5-9 UI cards are the watchlist. Reconstruct SPXW surface at each ET to find what picks share + how score maps to features.

behavior.one_thesis_per_day: Falcon forms ONE directional thesis and holds it ALL DAY — does NOT flip-flop. 07-23: 'stuck with its short thesis the entire day.' This is the core (our reversal sim failed BECAUSE it took both directions).
behavior.few_trades: ~1-3 executed/day (07-23 = 2). ~1.3/day avg ('1 loss in 2 weeks'). Watchlist cards != executed trades.
behavior.anchored_on_key_strike: Repeatedly plays ONE key strike/level: 7380P(07-23), 7410P(07-24 x3), 7430P(07-28 x2) = the day's magnet.
behavior.fades_toward_the_king: 07-17 'Falcon doesn't get bearish near the lows' — it fades TOWARD the mean/king (long near lows, short near highs), never chases the breakdown at an extreme.
behavior.patience: 'Calm and collected. Nothing but patience.' Waits for the setup.
behavior.rr: ~1:1.0-1.75 (NOT 3:1). Edge is the ~92% win rate (setup quality), not fat R:R.
behavior.scoring: 0-100 score per setup (cards show 64-95). Ranks which few to take. NOT expected-return — 95 was a Trinity Deflection (14/19 legs ≥30%), 64 a Trinity Confluence long. Conviction, not payout.

signals._note: Falcon/Talon name each setup on the card. The names are labels for GEX structure — this is the skeleton of the 0-100 score.
signals._REGIME_IS_NODE_LEVEL: CRITICAL (verified node_sign.mjs): the whole-surface net gamma is POSITIVE on every 2026 low-VIX day, so it does NOT discriminate. The setup switch is the SIGN OF THE NODE IN THE TRADE'S PATH. Pika (g0>0) = holds = FADE toward/off it (deflection). Barney (g0<0) = breaks = ride THROUGH it (trapdoor). Confirmed: 07-09 trapdoor short had a 7540 barney(-16M) right under spot 7542; 07-20 deflection long targeted the 7490 pika(+28M) king. The pick's own OTM strike is ~0 gamma — read the STRUCTURE around spot, not the strike.
signals.trinity_deflection: Fade off a DEALER-HELD wall — a pika price taps repeatedly but never closes through, and the wall holds/grows. 'Trinity' = SPX/SPY/QQQ radar all agree. CONFIRMED JUL 20: 7490 tapped 9x, rejected 9/9, king in 64% of frames; Falcon shorted each tap toward 7450-7470. The core reversal.
signals.trapdoor: Short THROUGH a barney (negative-gamma node below spot) = accelerant, momentum down. NOT a fade — a break. Talon 7535P/7540P/7545P Jul 9 & 13.
signals.barney_floor: Long off a barney acting as support (neg-gamma floor that flips) — the bull mirror of trapdoor. Talon 7535C Jul 13.
signals.trinity_confluence: Multiple structural signals + the 3-index radar align one direction. Falcon 7495C/7445C LONG Jul 17 (score 64).
signals.spy_rug: Cross-asset downside lead — SPY rugs first, SPX follows. Talon SPXW 7535P 'SPY RUG' Jul 13.
signals.spy_rev: Cross-asset reversal lead — SPY reverses first. Talon SPXW 7545C 'SPY REV' Jul 13.

vix._note: Glitch Jul 16: '$VIX below 16 and volatility spikes again.' The signal is COMPRESSION, not level.
vix.rule: VIX pinned at/below ~16 = coiled spring → vol expansion imminent. RAISES conviction on a deflection fade because the move will have RANGE into the target. High VIX alone is NOT bullish for the setup; compression-then-expansion is the tell. Score input = VIX regime (compressed vs elevated) + intraday direction of change, NOT raw level.
vix.user_intuition: User flagged VIX as important early; Glitch's own posts confirm it's a first-class input.
